newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to release jobless data July 18.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to release jobless data July 18.

text.p: Argentina's Economy Ministry will announce its twice-yearly unemployment figures, this time for the month of May, on July 18, the ministry's statistics institute INDEC said Monday.
The Argentine government releases its Permanent Home Survey, which includes employment figures, twice a year with statistics for May and October.

The last survey, for October 1996, showed an unemployment rate of 17.3 percent, after 17.1 percent in May last year. The Peronist government has forecast it will drop to 16.3 percent in this May's survey.
